decision.explanation: The central beneficial-ownership register (D-GOCSB, Tier 1) lists "Dormun Pefenka" (DOB 1994-06-15, 100%), while the current (16-day-old) business register shareholder excerpt (D-AX7AQ, Tier 1) shows "Relpe Petorvi" (DOB 1951-02-04, 100%, holder since 2024-10-17). This is a substantive, reliable-evidence contradiction of the register, not a typographical/transliteration error, so exception (a) fails. Exception (b) is unavailable because the register was last updated 2025-09-26 — after the 2024-10-17 change — yet still shows the old owner, and the business register (also an "Aurelia" register) cannot be confirmed independent of the central register's controlling authority. The customer's own declaration (D-VCRUE) names "Relpe Petorvi," matching the reliable evidence, so there is no basis to escalate on that ground; the risk record (D-36DVP) is "standard" with no alerts, so no concealment alert requires escalation. Under R2 the default action applies: report the discrepancy to the register within 14 calendar days.

The central register (D-GOCSB, tier 1) lists "Dormun Pefenka" (DOB 1994-06-15, 100%) as the sole beneficial owner of Narsorbelka B.V. The only other source naming a beneficial owner is the customer's self-declaration (D-VCRUE, tier 3), which names an entirely different person, "Relpe Petorvi" (DOB 1951-02-04, 100%) — not a typographical or transliteration variant. The internal risk record (D-36DVP, tier 1) is standard-risk with no alerts but names no beneficial owner. Under R2 I must verify the register against a source other than the register itself, and only a tier 1 or 2 document can confirm or contradict it; the customer's tier 3 declaration cannot be relied upon. Because no reliable (tier 1/2) source other than the register states who the beneficial owners are, I cannot determine whether a discrepancy exists, and the conflicting customer declaration requires clarification. The appropriate action is therefore to request a reliable document (e.g., a business-register shareholder excerpt or notarial deed) identifying the beneficial owners before making any discrepancy determination. No alert indicates concealment and the customer is standard-risk, so escalation is not yet required.

The central beneficial-ownership register (D-GOCSB) lists "Dormun Pefenka" (DOB 1994-06-15, 100%) as the beneficial owner, last updated 2025-09-26. The independent tier-1 Aurelia Business Register shareholder excerpt (D-AX7AQ, issued 2027-08-31, within the 30-day freshness window for the 2027-09-16 decision) shows "Relpe Petorvi" (DOB 1951-02-04, 100%, holder since 2024-10-17) as the sole shareholder. The two describe entirely different individuals (different name and date of birth), so this is a material discrepancy that is not a typographical or transliteration error (R2 exception (a) inapplicable). Because the register was last updated 2025-09-26 yet still reflects the prior owner, it cannot be treated as "merely outdated" with certainty, so exception (b) does not cleanly apply; the internal risk record (D-36DVP) shows a standard rating with no alert, so there is no internal indication of concealment requiring escalation. Under R2, the default action when reliable non-register evidence differs from the register is to report the discrepancy to the register within 14 calendar days.

The central beneficial-ownership register (D-GOCSB) lists Dormun Pefenka (DOB 1994-06-15, 100%) as beneficial owner, and the independent Tier 1 business-register shareholder excerpt (D-AX7AQ, issued 2027-08-31, current within 30 days) confirms the same person, so the register entry is accurate and there is no register discrepancy. However, the customer's own self-declaration (D-VCRUE) names a different beneficial owner, Relpe Petorvi (DOB 1951-02-04, 100%). Under R2, when a customer's declaration names different beneficial owners than the reliable evidence, the agent must request clarification or escalate. With standard risk and no internal concealment alert (D-36DVP), the proportionate action is to request clarification (request_document) of the conflicting self-declaration rather than escalate as suspicious.
